texts: Why does the Council redistribute mire-essence at the full moon?

fields.sentence: Why does the Council redistribute mire-essence at the full moon?

q2_gaps: a definite NP naming a recurring natural/astronomical time point ('at the full moon') as a Time filler: the instruction set's Time fillers are structured calendar/clock terms, speech-anchored deictic constants, and an enumerated day-part list (morning/afternoon/evening/night, dawn/noon/dusk), and it gives no rule for whether such a phrase becomes a bare Time constant or the ordinary definite witness that 'the N' would otherwise mint
review.notes: Binding 'the Council' by kind rather than Name is right (capitalized bare class word = common noun by default), Theme for redistributed mire-essence follows the no-change test, and the bare-symbol Time filler is the most defensible of the undetermined options.
